scheme_name: Development and Maintenance of Orchard Cum Horti Nurseries
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture
Applicant must own or lease land of at least 200 sq ms
benefits_summary: Provides training, awareness and technology support along with the production of high‑yielding, disease‑free planting material for farmers.
